text.arabic_uthmani: وَمَا هَٰذِهِ ٱلْحَيَوٰةُ ٱلدُّنْيَآ إِلَّا لَهْوٌۭ وَلَعِبٌۭ ۚ وَإِنَّ ٱلدَّارَ ٱلْءَاخِرَةَ لَهِىَ ٱلْحَيَوَانُ ۚ لَوْ كَانُوا۟ يَعْلَمُونَ

words.gloss_range: opening connector that resumes the prior correction and launches a restrictive verdict
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) keeps the ayah tied to the prior correction while it opens a fresh verdict. After the prior confession of divine action, it carries the failed reasoning from the previous scene into a nominal judgment about worldly life, then prepares the antithesis between deflation and emphatic affirmation.

topics.headline: resumptive verdict after prior correction
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah opens as the content of a continuing argument, not as an isolated maxim.
topics.reason: QAC allows coordination or resumption, and the discourse boundary moves from prior dialogue into a universal nominal verdict.

topics.headline: whereas-like contrastive link
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the opening connector holding continuity and contrast together as the ayah turns from confessed divine action to worldly-life valuation.
topics.reason: The particle can carry circumstantial or contrastive force, and the following structure creates a negative-positive antithesis.

words.gloss_range: negative particle beginning the negation-plus-exception restriction over worldly life
words.prose: {{ar:مَا}} ({{tr:mā}}) is not bare negation. It opens the restrictive frame that makes the reader pass through denial before receiving the reduced residue, and that negative pressure is answered later by an emphatic positive assertion.

topics.headline: negation that becomes restriction
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the negation first strips worldly life of rival claims before the exception names what remains.
topics.reason: The local grammar explicitly marks a negation-plus-exception restriction, not a simple denial.

topics.headline: negative frame paired with positive assertion
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the first clause diminishes through restriction while the second clause elevates through stacked assertion.
topics.reason: The ayah has a restricted nominal clause followed by an emphatic inna-clause, creating a balanced antithesis.

words.gloss_range: near feminine demonstrative pointing to the immediately named worldly life as the subject of judgment

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the life noun that resolves the demonstrative

words.prose: {{ar:هَٰذِهِ}} ({{tr:hādhihi}}) points first, and {{ar:ٱلْحَيَوٰةُ}} ({{tr:al-ḥayātu}}) then names what the pointing gesture means. The effect is immediate and specific: this experienced life is brought under judgment before the restriction reduces it. Accepted variant evidence can shift the pointing word's cadence, but it keeps the same referent fixed.

topics.headline: definite feminine deictic subject
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices a pointed, grammatically fixed referent before the life phrase is explicitly named.
topics.reason: The feminine demonstrative is the subject of the nominal sentence and is resolved by apposition to the following worldly-life phrase.

topics.headline: near demonstrative as immediate pointed object
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the judged life is the immediate, shared life at hand, not an abstract distant category.
topics.reason: The demonstrative is near deixis and its referent is locally identified, supporting the pointed rhetorical effect.

topics.headline: accepted demonstrative variant affects cadence not referent
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that variant cadence can lighten or weight the pointing word while the same referent remains fixed.
topics.reason: The variant evidence preserves the same feminine demonstrative function, so it can illustrate cadence but not change the local reference.

words.gloss_range: definite worldly-life noun, appositive to the demonstrative and locally reduced by the restriction

words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْحَيَوٰةُ}} ({{tr:al-ḥayātu}}) clarifies the opening pointer and totalizes the category being judged. As a standard life noun, it becomes the lower member of the ayah's life-language arc: {{ar:ٱلْحَيَوٰةُ}} ({{tr:al-ḥayātu}}) is reduced in the first clause, while {{ar:ٱلْحَيَوَانُ}} ({{tr:al-ḥayawānu}}) later names intensified living in the emphatic predicate. The phrase also belongs to a recurring worldly-life dismissal formula (2:85; 6:32; 47:36). The prior revival scene (29:63) sharpens this handoff without turning the local noun into a reviving verb.

topics.headline: appositive life category under restriction
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the demonstrative is clarified into the known category of worldly life before the restriction acts on it.
topics.reason: QAC and attachment evidence identify the word as the appositive life noun within the restricted nominal clause.

topics.headline: ordinary life set before intensified living
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices morphology grading life-language from ordinary life at the opening to intensified living at the climax.
topics.reason: The local ayah repeats the life root in two different nominal shapes, with the later predicate carrying the stronger form.

topics.headline: earth-revival sign handed into life hierarchy
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the prior earth-revival sign (29:63) becomes the ground for judging which life is real, while the local word remains the worldly-life noun.
topics.reason: The prior ayah contains revival language, but local grammar here selects the noun of life rather than a causative reviving verb.

topics.headline: recognizable worldly-life formula
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the phrase belongs to a repeated Quranic worldly-life dismissal pattern, not a one-off description.
topics.reason: The rows cite repeated worldly-life formula contexts, and the local phrase has the same restricted valuation.

topics.headline: life root arc into knowledge coda
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices a whole-ayah movement from ordinary life through true living toward the knowledge needed to perceive the contrast.
topics.reason: The local life-root return and final knowledge coda are both visible in the ayah structure.

words.prose: {{ar:ٱلدُّنْيَآ}} ({{tr:al-dunyā}}) narrows the life under judgment to the nearer and lower mode of life. Its adjective form keeps the critique attached to {{ar:ٱلْحَيَوٰةُ}} ({{tr:al-ḥayātu}}), while the later {{ar:ٱلْءَاخِرَةَ}} ({{tr:al-ākhirata}}) supplies the opposing side of the ayah's axis. Same-surah worldly attachment (29:25) becomes here an ontological verdict, and the prior dead-earth imagery makes apparent life judged by consequence rather than animation (29:63).

topics.headline: nearer and lower life qualifier
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that nearness and lowness are compressed into the qualifier of life.
topics.reason: The word is an adjectival modifier of the life noun and its root/form evidence supports both proximity and lower-rank pressure.

topics.headline: nearer life answered by final abode
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the ayah building its main axis from nearer-lower life to later-final abode.
topics.reason: The local structure places this qualifier in the first phrase and the final qualifier in the second phrase.

topics.headline: same-surah worldly attachment becomes verdict
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that earlier worldly attachment and dead-earth imagery in the surah feed into this final reduction of worldly life (29:25; 29:63).
topics.reason: The rows give concrete same-surah links, and they support a local thread without overriding the immediate adjective function.

topics.headline: exception hinge of exhaustive reduction
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the exception particle turns prior negation into exhaustive identification of what worldly life amounts to.
topics.reason: QAC marks the particle as completing restriction with the preceding negation.

topics.headline: exception governs the whole paired predicate
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the following two predicates form one restricted payload rather than separate loose descriptions.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence coordinates the second predicate to the first under the same restricted nominal clause.

words.root_gloss_range: root range of diversion, neglectful absorption, and caused forgetfulness; local noun selects diversion as a class predicate

words.prose: {{ar:لَهْوٌ}} ({{tr:lahwun}}) is the first reduced predicate after the exception. Its indefinite maṣdar form classifies worldly life as diversion itself, and its force points away from the weightier reality later named by {{ar:ٱلْحَيَوَانُ}} ({{tr:al-ḥayawānu}}). Joined with {{ar:لَعِبٌ}} ({{tr:laʿibun}}), it forms a compact double verdict rather than a lone synonym, with matched endings making the dismissal audible.

topics.headline: indefinite maṣdar class predicate
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that diversion is predicated as a category over worldly life, not named as one isolated amusement.
topics.reason: The word is an indefinite nominative maṣdar functioning as predicate in the restricted nominal sentence.

topics.headline: diversion away from weightier life
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices diversion as movement away from the true living named later, not just harmless amusement.
topics.reason: The lexical rows press diversion and forgetfulness, and the ayah supplies the displaced object through the later true-life predicate.

topics.headline: paired dismissal with play
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices a fixed paired verdict: passive diversion and active purposeless play work together.
topics.reason: The local coordination and recurring formula support the double predicate as a structured pair.

topics.headline: shared tanwīn cadence binds the pair
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the matched endings make the dismissal compact and audible.
topics.reason: The sound row is locally tied to the two adjacent indefinite predicates.

words.gloss_range: coordinating connector that joins the second predicate to the first under the same restriction

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the first restricted predicate

words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) keeps {{ar:لَهْوٌ}} ({{tr:lahwun}}) and {{ar:لَعِبٌ}} ({{tr:laʿibun}}) together under the same restriction while preventing them from collapsing into one word. The critique therefore has two co-present faces: distraction away from weight and activity without lasting yield.

topics.headline: connector binding two distinct predicates
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that diversion and play are simultaneous and distinct under one restriction.
topics.reason: QAC and attachment evidence show coordination of the second predicate to the first.

topics.headline: light hinge between paired nouns
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the short connector audibly separating the two nouns without breaking their paired cadence.
topics.reason: The phonetic row is locally grounded between two adjacent tanwīn nouns.

words.root_gloss_range: root range of play, game-like activity, and purposeless engagement; local noun abstracts that activity as a predicate over worldly life

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the paired diversion predicate

words.prose: {{ar:لَعِبٌ}} ({{tr:laʿibun}}) completes the reduced predicate pair. It adds active, purposeless engagement to the prior diversion of {{ar:لَهْوٌ}} ({{tr:lahwun}}), so the two nouns are complementary rather than interchangeable. Their short balanced cadence makes the two-word verdict feel fixed, and the recurring doublet in worldly-life contexts (6:32; 47:36; 57:20) makes the local verdict formulaic and final.

topics.headline: second maṣdar predicate of purposeless activity

topics.reason: The word is the second indefinite maṣdar predicate coordinated with the first under the same restriction.

topics.headline: play distinguished from diversion

topics.reason: The lexical rows distinguish the two roots while the local syntax pairs them.

topics.headline: worldly-life hendiadys across corpus
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices a recurring Quranic formula for worldly-life dismissal, here placed opposite true living.
topics.reason: The rows cite concrete formulaic parallels including 6:32, 47:36, and 57:20.

topics.headline: balanced short cadence of the doublet
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that sound balance makes the two-word verdict feel fixed and compact.
topics.reason: The sound row is locally tied to the adjacent paired maṣdars.

words.gloss_range: transitional connector opening the contrastive emphatic assertion
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) is the ayah's central turn. It does not merely add a second sentence; it joins the diminished worldly-life clause to the elevated hereafter clause, making deflation and affirmation answer each other. That pivot also prepares the closing move from ontology into judgment of those who fail to know.

topics.headline: pivot from deflation to affirmation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the ayah turning from a depleted worldly-life verdict into an emphatic hereafter assertion.
topics.reason: QAC identifies the connector as transitional, and the following clause is an emphatic inna-clause.

topics.headline: two nominal clauses read together
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the negative and positive clauses are joined as one antithetical structure.
topics.reason: The connector binds the restricted nominal clause to the emphatic nominal clause.

topics.headline: prepares closing third-person diagnosis
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the pivot preparing movement from ontology into judgment of those who fail to know.
topics.reason: The discourse profile connects the pivoting structure to the later third-person knowledge coda.

words.gloss_range: assertive particle opening and governing the emphatic hereafter nominal clause

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the governed subject of the inna-clause

words.prose: {{ar:إِنَّ}} ({{tr:inna}}) opens the positive half with governed assertion. It holds {{ar:ٱلدَّارَ}} ({{tr:al-dāra}}) as the subject phrase and prepares the predicate {{ar:ٱلْحَيَوَانُ}} ({{tr:al-ḥayawānu}}), while the later emphatic elements make the claim heavier than a bare nominal sentence. The architecture states what the final abode is, not an event that happens there.

topics.headline: emphatic particle governing the subject phrase
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the hereafter claim is grammatically governed and asserted before the predicate arrives.
topics.reason: The particle opens an emphatic nominal sentence and governs the subject phrase as the ism.

topics.headline: start of stacked emphasis frame
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the positive claim receives more assertional weight than ordinary affirmation.
topics.reason: The local inna-clause is reinforced by the later emphatic lām and pronoun of separation.

topics.headline: stable identity rather than event clause
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the clause states what the final abode is, not what happens there.
topics.reason: The second beat is an emphatic nominal architecture rather than a verbal event frame.

words.gloss_range: definite concrete abode noun governed as the emphatic clause subject, narrowed to the final abode by its qualifier
words.root_gloss_range: root range of dwelling, circling, returning, and domain; local noun selects abode while return-point pressure remains available

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the qualifier that makes the abode final/later

words.prose: {{ar:ٱلدَّارَ}} ({{tr:al-dāra}}) is the governed subject of the emphatic clause, a definite abode-domain awaiting its predicate. Its feminine form holds {{ar:ٱلْءَاخِرَةَ}} ({{tr:al-ākhirata}}) and later {{ar:هِيَ}} ({{tr:hiya}}) together, so the true-life claim attaches to the whole final-abode phrase. The root's return-image survives as pressure, but the local sense remains abode rather than abstract rotation. The fixed final-abode phrase also reverses the surah-local image of collapsed dwellings (29:37).

topics.headline: definite abode as governed subject
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the final abode as a known domain held under assertion before its predicate is named.
topics.reason: QAC and attachment evidence mark the noun as the accusative subject governed by the assertive particle.

topics.headline: feminine noun controls qualifier and pronoun
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the whole abode phrase staying unified through adjective and pronoun agreement.
topics.reason: The feminine noun governs the following adjective and the pronoun of separation.

topics.headline: abode with return-point root pressure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices abode-language carrying return-point pressure, while local grammar keeps the selected sense as final dwelling/domain.
topics.reason: The root field includes revolving and returning, but the surface is the concrete abode noun, not an abstract cycle noun.

topics.headline: fixed final-abode collocation and surah echo

topics.reason: The rows provide a fixed collocation and a concrete same-surah echo to 29:37.

words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْءَاخِرَةَ}} ({{tr:al-ākhirata}}) completes the subject phrase as the later/final qualifier of {{ar:ٱلدَّارَ}} ({{tr:al-dāra}}). Its after-coming force makes the final abode the reality that follows and replaces the nearer life. It answers {{ar:ٱلدُّنْيَآ}} ({{tr:al-dunyā}}) by opposition: the nearer-lower life is met by the later-final abode. Only after that phrase is complete does {{ar:ٱلْحَيَوَانُ}} ({{tr:al-ḥayawānu}}) deliver the emphatic predicate.

topics.headline: agreed final qualifier of the abode

topics.reason: QAC and attachment evidence identify the word as a definite adjective modifying the abode noun.

topics.headline: after-coming participial force
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the final abode as the later reality that follows and replaces the nearer life.
topics.reason: The word is a feminine active-participle/adjectival form from the after/later root.

topics.headline: latter term answering nearer/lower term
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the ayah contrast resting on the nearer-lower versus later-final lexical axis.

topics.headline: subject phrase completed before true-life predicate

It works inside the frame begun by {{ar:إِنَّ}} ({{tr:inna}}), directing attention toward the predicate {{ar:ٱلْحَيَوَانُ}} ({{tr:al-ḥayawānu}}) as the positive climax rather than adding a separate lexical meaning.

topics.headline: emphatic lām at predicate threshold

words.prose: {{ar:هِيَ}} ({{tr:hiya}}) points back to {{ar:ٱلدَّارَ}} ({{tr:al-dāra}}) and functions as a separator before {{ar:ٱلْحَيَوَانُ}} ({{tr:al-ḥayawānu}}). The result is not a spare pronoun but a staged identification: the final abode itself is the living reality. It also completes the triple emphasis, with assertion, reinforcement, and separation converging on the same predicate.

words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْحَيَوَانُ}} ({{tr:al-ḥayawānu}}) is the ayah's climactic predicate. It does not merely repeat {{ar:ٱلْحَيَوٰةُ}} ({{tr:al-ḥayātu}}); it upgrades life-language into a definite, intensified living reality and assigns that identity to {{ar:ٱلدَّارَ}} ({{tr:al-dāra}}). Derivational debate affects how tightly the two life terms echo, but not the local predicate sense. Its rarity and emphatic slot make morphology, distribution, and syntax converge on the same claim.

words.prose: {{ar:يَعْلَمُونَ}} ({{tr:yaʿlamūna}}) closes the ayah on missing knowledge. Under {{ar:لَوْ}} ({{tr:law}}) and {{ar:كَانُوا۟}} ({{tr:kānū}}), it names an ongoing awareness they do not have, and its unstated object is the whole contrast just given. That missing knowledge should have responded to marked evidence, including the prior rain-and-revival sign (29:63), while the local verb remains simple knowing. The final word therefore turns the life hierarchy into an epistemic test, and the same coda functions as a recognizable refrain of epistemic failure (2:102; 16:41; 39:26).

topics.headline: imperfect knowing under counterfactual auxiliary
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices knowledge as ongoing awareness that is precisely absent in the counterfactual coda.
topics.reason: The imperfect verb is the complement of the auxiliary in the final counterfactual construction.

topics.headline: object of knowing omitted but recoverable
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that what they fail to know is the whole preceding hierarchy, not a small unstated fact.
topics.reason: The verb has no stated object, and attachment support warns against inserting a narrow object by default.

topics.headline: sign-marker pressure in knowledge root
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the absent knowledge should have arisen from marked evidence, while local grammar still selects simple knowing.
topics.reason: The root-family sign/marker pressure is coherent with the prior rain-and-revival sign, but the surface verb is simple Form I knowing.

topics.headline: formulaic tragic epistemic coda
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the final phrase as a recognizable refrain of epistemic failure, including 2:102, 16:41, 29:64, and 39:26.
topics.reason: The rows cite concrete formulaic recurrences and same-surah knowledge discourse.

topics.headline: ayah closes on missing knowledge
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the last word shifts the payoff from ontology to perception: the hierarchy fails to register because knowledge is absent.
topics.reason: The verb is the final word and completes the counterfactual condition after the two main verdicts.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The repeated H-Y-Y nouns at words 3 and 12 frame dunya, diversion, and play against the emphatic later abode as al-hayawan.
baseline_models.mechanism: The same life-root names both sides, but the near side is occupied by attention-switching and action without a sound end, whereas the later dwelling is predicated as life itself. The contrast is therefore between a diverted mode of living and concentrated, fully realized life, not simply existence versus nonexistence.

activation_trace.role: Animate life shared by both nouns keeps the contrast between two modes or intensities of living.
Proximity makes dunya the immediately available horizon that captures attention.
Being occupied by one thing away from another supplies the displacement mechanism.
Activity lacking a sound intended end supplies the contrast with realized life.
What comes after the first locates the contrasting life beyond the immediate phase.

changed_reading.before: Worldly life is temporary entertainment, while the afterlife lasts forever.
changed_reading.after: The near life is still life, but it is lived in displaced attention and end-less activity; the later abode is emphatically life gathered into its proper mode.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Dunya at word 4 is paired structurally with akhirah at word 10.
baseline_models.mechanism: The most economical polarity is near versus later. Moral smallness remains available in the root inventory, but the ayah does not need it: the immediate phase is dangerous because its proximity lets it masquerade as the whole, while the later phase is easily treated as absent because it follows.

activation_trace.role: Nearness supplies perceptual and temporal immediacy without requiring inherent vileness.
Laterness supplies sequence and deferral as the counterpart to nearness.
Distraction explains how proximity, rather than intrinsic evil, distorts valuation.

changed_reading.before: Dunya is condemned because it is intrinsically low and worthless.
changed_reading.after: Dunya is the near layer whose immediacy distracts people into mistaking the first phase for the total reality.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Al-hayawan at word 12 intensifies the H-Y-Y root inside the later dwelling.
baseline_models.mechanism: The life-root inventory includes fertility and effective benefit, while dar supplies settled residence. This permits al-hayawan to denote not bare endless animation but life that sustains, benefits, and bears fruit without the leakage of diversion.

activation_trace.role: Rain-made fertility supplies productive and renewing vitality as a possible intensity of life.
Life as effective benefit makes full life consequential rather than merely prolonged.
Residence and attachment to a dwelling give the vitality a stable habitation.

changed_reading.before: Al-hayawan means only unending biological existence.
changed_reading.after: Al-hayawan can name settled, fruitful, beneficial vitality: life that fully performs what life is for.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The conditional close at words 14-15 makes knowing the missing capacity by which the two lives would be distinguished.
baseline_models.mechanism: The knowledge-root can be both disclosure and a mark that distinguishes and guides. The conditional therefore concerns failure to read the differentiating signs between apparent life and life itself, not mere absence of a proposition.

activation_trace.role: Occurrence in time makes the conditional a question of whether knowledge is actually present and operative.
A distinguishing mark that guides supplies knowledge as practical discrimination between the two modes of life.

changed_reading.before: If they knew the fact that the afterlife is better, they would agree.
changed_reading.after: If they could read and follow the marks that distinguish apparent vitality from real vitality, the hierarchy of the two lives would become operative.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opening sequence moves from a spoken claim, through assay, to truth and falsehood becoming manifest. It revises the focus conditional so that knowing life's hierarchy is tested disclosure embodied in allegiance, not information left inert.

activation_trace.role: Assaying metal or persons supplies a process that exposes the quality hidden by a claim.
Knowledge as disclosure names what the test makes manifest.
Truth realized in promise and act makes the known distinction behavioral.
Opposition to truth supplies the failed outcome disclosed by testing.
Disclosure anchors the context's assay mechanism back to the focus conditional.

structural_cues: 29:2-3 sequences saying belief, being tested, and the truthful and lying becoming known.
The focus also closes with a conditional failure of knowing.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: claim, assay, disclosed truth, and disclosed falsehood. Reader arrow: tested conduct is what makes knowledge of real life operative. Live alternative: the opening knowledge language may concern public manifestation of what is already divinely known rather than human learning.

changed_reading.before: Knowing at 29:64 is possession of correct eschatological information.
changed_reading.after: Knowing is an assayed recognition whose truth appears in what one treats as life under pressure.

context_deltas.mechanism: The first creation is paired with return, then observation of earthly origination leads to a specifically later genesis. This makes al-hayawan a newly constituted order of life rather than indefinite extension of the near life's present mode.

activation_trace.role: Beginning explicitly coupled with return supplies a two-stage creation pattern.
Return after departure supplies continuity across the two stages.
Bringing a thing into being makes the later stage a produced genesis, not mere duration.
Laterness identifies that generated order as the phase following the first.
Animate life anchors the context's second genesis to al-hayawan.

structural_cues: 29:19 pairs initiating creation with repeating it.
29:20 names the second event the later genesis before 29:64 names the later abode life itself.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: first beginning, return, and later origination. Reader arrow: the emphatic life of 29:64 is the mode produced by that later genesis. Live alternative: the sequence may emphasize divine ability while leaving the qualitative difference between the two lives unstated.

changed_reading.before: The afterlife is the current kind of life continued forever.
changed_reading.after: The later abode is life under a second origination: continuous with persons who return, but qualitatively reconstituted.

context_deltas.mechanism: Idol allegiance generates mutual affection inside the near life, then that fellowship reverses into reciprocal repudiation, expulsion, and a failed refuge. Diversion and play can therefore be socially organized: a group sustains an apparent world through mutual approval until the later accounting reverses its bonds.

activation_trace.role: Mutual affection supplies the adhesive that makes a shared diversion durable.
Corporate life as a kin-like group activates a social rather than merely individual reading of worldly life.
Nearness confines the alliance's apparent success to the immediate phase.
Expulsion under wrath reverses the earlier affection and exposes its instability.
Joining a sheltering collectivity makes the final failed refuge the endpoint of the social mechanism.
Attention displaced by another object anchors the alliance mechanism to diversion.

structural_cues: 29:25 explicitly places idol-mediated mutual affection within worldly life and then stages its reversal on resurrection.
The focus coordinates diversion and play before contrasting the later abode.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: near-life affection, reciprocal repudiation, expulsion, and failed refuge. Reader arrow: mutual approval can function as the machinery of diversion and play. Live alternative: the affection may be only a consequence of idolatry rather than an explanation of lahw and la'ib.

changed_reading.before: Diversion and play are private leisure activities.
changed_reading.after: They can be collective worlds maintained by mutual approval, whose bonds invert when the later order discloses their object.

context_deltas.mechanism: The spider's constructed shelter is the weakest house, and its warning closes with the same knowing conditional as the focus. The later dar consequently answers a load-bearing question: which dwelling and patronage can actually hold its dependents, rather than merely looking inhabitable.

activation_trace.role: A deliberately struck comparison supplies the house as an interpretive model rather than incidental scenery.
Shelter and dwelling supply the structural analogue for the focus's dar.
Loss of strength makes apparent shelter fail its load-bearing function.
The identical conditional of knowing directly couples the weak house to the focus contrast.
Reason as restraint from ignorance makes the house comparison something to be functionally grasped.
Stable residence anchors the house test to the later abode.

structural_cues: 29:41 and 29:64 both end with law kanu ya'lamun.
29:43 says the intervening comparisons are grasped by knowers, strengthening the deliberate parallel.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: a weak house, failed patrons, the repeated knowing close, and reasoned comparisons. Reader arrow: dar in 29:64 is read by the shelter's functional criterion of what can truly bear dependence. Live alternative: bayt and dar need not carry identical lexical nuances, so this is a contextual analogy rather than synonymy.

changed_reading.before: The later abode is simply the location where future life occurs.
changed_reading.after: The later abode is the only load-bearing habitation: a dwelling whose life and patronage do not collapse under dependence.

context_deltas.mechanism: Immediately after the house parable, heavens and earth are said to be created in truth. Thus calling worldly life diversion and play cannot flatten creation itself into purposeless unreality; it diagnoses an aimless and attention-displacing way of inhabiting a truthfully ordered creation.

activation_trace.role: Deliberate bringing into existence supplies a real created order rather than an illusion.
Stable correspondence to reality supplies purpose and firmness to the created order.
Displacement from one concern by another locates the defect in attention.
Action without a sound intended end locates the defect in human use and orientation.

structural_cues: 29:44 asserts truthful creation before 29:64 classifies worldly life as diversion and play.
29:45 then presents practices that restrain wrongdoing, showing purposeful action remains possible within the present order.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: real creation in truth followed by purposeful recitation and prayer. Reader arrow: lahw and la'ib judge a mode of attention and action inside creation, not the ontological worth of creation. Live alternative: the terms may still characterize the present life's total form relative to the next while preserving creation's divine purpose.

changed_reading.before: The verse says the created world is pointless or unreal.
changed_reading.after: Creation is real and purposive; worldly life becomes play when its inhabitants divert its activities from their true end.

context_deltas.mechanism: People demand that the deferred event be hurried, but it has a fixed term and is described as already surrounding them before its above-and-below manifestation. Laterness can therefore mean delayed disclosure of an encompassing order, not simple remoteness or nonpresence.

activation_trace.role: Demanding acceleration supplies the mistaken equation of delay with absence.
A fixed temporal limit supplies scheduled deferral rather than uncertainty.
Concrete encirclement supplies a present encompassing relation before disclosure.
The upper direction gives one boundary of total manifested enclosure.
The lower direction completes the image of enclosure on every vertical side.
Deferral to a later time anchors scheduled disclosure to akhirah.
Circling and enclosure let dar carry an exploratory encompassing dimension.

structural_cues: 29:53-55 moves from demands for haste, to a named term, to present encirclement, to manifestation above and below.
29:64 contrasts the near phase with the later abode rather than with a merely distant place.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: haste, fixed term, present encirclement, and later directional manifestation. Reader arrow: the later order is already determinative while awaiting disclosure. Live alternative: the present tense of encirclement may be proleptic certainty rather than current ontological enclosure.

changed_reading.before: The later abode is absent now and begins only after the near world ends.
changed_reading.after: The later order may already encompass the near life while remaining scheduled for full disclosure.

context_deltas.mechanism: The late sequence passes through universal death into emplacement in chambers, abiding rivers, provisioned creatures, and rain that revives dead earth. It thickens al-hayawan into a divinely supplied ecology of settled, regenerative, enduring life rather than a bare assertion of endless duration.

activation_trace.role: Departure of life and power sets the boundary that the later vitality crosses.
Assigning a settled place supplies habitation rather than disembodied survival.
Stable continuance resistant to decay supplies the enduring dimension.
Living movement upon earth broadens vitality beyond human self-sufficiency.
Nourishing provision makes creaturely life continuously received and sustained.
Water delivered by pouring supplies the material carrier of revival.
Rain-driven revival of dead earth immediately activates productive life in the focus.
Life as effective benefit gathers sustenance, habitation, endurance, and renewal into al-hayawan.

structural_cues: 29:57-63 sequences death, return, settled chambers, abiding, creaturely provision, and revival after death.
The rain-revival statement occurs immediately before the focus's doubled H-Y-Y contrast.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: death, emplacement, endurance, nourishment, water, and revived earth. Reader arrow: these form a material analogy and feature-set for the later abode's al-hayawan. Live alternative: the rain image may primarily prove resurrection's possibility without specifying its lived quality.

changed_reading.before: The real life differs from worldly life chiefly because it never ends.
changed_reading.after: The real life is an abiding habitat of received nourishment and renewed fruitfulness, life after death that continually acts as life.

context_deltas.mechanism: Danger at sea strips worship to exclusive allegiance; rescue onto land is followed by renewed association and pleasurable use, then by deferred knowing. Lahw becomes the post-crisis replacement of disclosed dependence with enjoyable normality, a recurrent attentional relapse rather than entertainment alone.

activation_trace.role: Mounting a conveyance places the person inside the perilous transition.
A vessel moving in water supplies the unstable setting that concentrates allegiance.
Exclusive separation from association supplies crisis-disclosed singleness of allegiance.
Obedience and submission make the disclosure behavioral, not merely verbal.
Pleasurable benefit supplies the normality that can reoccupy attention after rescue.
Future disclosure shows that enjoyable relapse postpones operative recognition.
Replacement of one concern by another anchors the rescue-relapse cycle to diversion.

structural_cues: 29:65 moves from peril, exclusive invocation, and rescue to immediate renewed association.
29:66 pairs pleasurable use with a future knowing formula just after the focus's failed knowing formula.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: concentrated allegiance in danger, rescue, relapse, enjoyment, and deferred disclosure. Reader arrow: restored comfort displaces what danger made known and thus functions as lahw. Live alternative: the enjoyment clause may operate chiefly as an ironic threat rather than a psychology of distraction.

changed_reading.before: Lahw is optional amusement added to ordinary life.
changed_reading.after: Lahw is ordinary life reoccupying attention after reality has been disclosed, converting received rescue into a return to substitute allegiances.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah closes with strenuous effort answered by guidance into traversable paths. The focus's knowledge can thus be read as wayfinding: signs become knowledge when effort is met by direction into a lived route toward real life.

activation_trace.role: Exerting full capacity under difficulty supplies the active condition of discovery.
Gentle direction toward a true path supplies knowledge as received orientation.
An extended traversable road turns orientation into a course of life.
A mark that distinguishes and guides anchors closing wayfinding to the focus's missing knowledge.

structural_cues: 29:69 is the surah's final answer to repeated failures of knowing, reasoning, and recognizing signs.
Its effort-guidance-path sequence converts cognition into movement.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: strenuous effort, granted guidance, and traversable paths. Reader arrow: the knowing absent in 29:64 becomes real through guided wayfinding. Live alternative: guidance may be the consequence of prior commitment rather than the semantic content of knowing.

changed_reading.before: The ayah ends by regretting an intellectual deficit.
changed_reading.after: The deficit is failed wayfinding: signs of real life have not become a path traversed through effort and guidance.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates peripheral birth and pregnancy branches rather than the ordinary temporal senses. It remains anchored to dunya, the doubled life-root, and the packet's later genesis. Render only as a gestational material analogy, never as the lexical meaning required by the ayah.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Dunya at word 4, the doubled H-Y-Y nouns, and the later genesis of 29:20 permit a birth-shaped relation between the two lives.

activation_trace.role: Nearness of parturition recasts the near phase as approaching an emergence.
Fertile life supplies growth within and beyond the transitional phase.
The pregnancy and arising image gives the explicitly later genesis a gestational material shape.

changed_reading.before: The near life is merely a short waiting period before a separate afterlife.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the near life is a gestating phase nearing delivery into the later origination of full life.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is branch-distant because la'ib ordinarily denotes play, while the activated branch names sunlit heat threads or mirage. It remains anchored to the focus word and is sharpened by the nearby sun and real reviving water. Downstream prose should mark it as a perceptual analogy, not replace the ordinary sense of play.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: La'ib at word 7 can carry an image of sunlit shimmer, set against al-hayawan and the real water-revival immediately before the focus.

activation_trace.role: Threadlike heat shimmer or mirage supplies apparent patterned substance that cannot be inhabited.
The visible sun activates the optical setting of the shimmer image.
Actual water that revives earth contrasts materially with water-like appearance.
Fertile vitality makes real life water-bearing and productive rather than optically suggestive.

changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, play also pictures a heat-shimmer world: motion and apparent texture mistaken for the water-bearing substance of life.

strongest_changes: The repeated knowing formula at the spider house turns the later abode into a load-bearing habitation rather than a neutral destination.
Creation in truth revises diversion and play from a verdict of cosmic purposelessness into a diagnosis of misdirected attention and action.
Death, settled chambers, provisioned creatures, and rain-revival make al-hayawan an enduring regenerative habitat, not bare endlessness.
The opening assay and closing guidance make knowing a disclosed and traversed distinction rather than inert eschatological information.
summary.what_was_special: The whole-surah packet creates unusually tight echoes around 29:64: the exact knowing close follows the weak house, truthful creation protects the present cosmos from nihilistic reading, immediate rain-revival activates the doubled life-root, and the ship sequence performs lahw as relapse after disclosed dependence.
remaining_uncertainties: Al-hayawan may foreground intensity, duration, productive benefit, or all three without fixing their relative weight.
The encompassing and load-bearing dimensions of dar are contextually strong but exceed a minimal lexical rendering of abode.
The social, gestational, and heat-shimmer readings should remain qualified activations rather than controlling interpretations.

reader_a.activated_readings_md: 1. **Near life as attention captured by a secondary occupation.** ل ه و B001 is being diverted from a concern by another occupation; B002 is amusement or enjoyment by metonymy. The near life is restricted to diversion/play, then contrasted with the later abode as the living reality. I infer that the defect is not activity itself but mis-ranked attention: الدنيا reads as a field that diverts concern from the durable abode when mistaken for the whole of life.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 29:65's ship crisis strips away the occupations that sustain divided allegiance. The later scene shows diversion not as harmless play but as a covering that danger can temporarily remove.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Near life is diagnosed by attentional diversion and aimlessness, not nonexistence.** Lexical evidence: `ٱلْحَيَاة`, root `ح ي ي`, `B003` (living creature or animate being); `ٱلدُّنْيَا`, root `د ن و`, `B002` (nearer/lower side); `لَهْو`, root `ل ه و`, `B001` (being diverted from a concern by another occupation); and `لَعِب`, root `ل ع ب`, `B001` (non-serious action without a sound aim). Structural cue: the restrictive construction defines the present life by two functional failures, after `29:61-63` showed correct answers failing to govern conduct and before `29:65-67` show danger-purity reversing into association. Assigned role: diversion displaces the governing concern; play expends action without durable aim. Abductive move: I infer that the critique concerns dominant use and orientation, not denial that present life is biologically alive. Reading change: worldly life becomes an attention-and-purpose problem.

2. **The later abode concentrates animate life as the durable reality.** Lexical evidence: `ٱلْآخِرَة`, root `ء خ ر`, `B001` (later than the first); emphatic `ٱلْحَيَوَان`, root `ح ي ي`, `B003` (animate being) with `B013` (life as benefit or saving good); and `يَعْلَمُون`, root `ع ل م`, `B001` (knowing as clear). Structural cue: near life and later abode are opposed, while the surrounding ayat display death-revival, permanent chambers, and unstable ship-to-land allegiance. Assigned role: the intensified life noun assigns durable vitality to the latter abode; knowledge would reorder present aims around it. Abductive move: I infer qualitative concentration from the emphatic pronoun and root repetition, without reducing present life to literal death. Reading change: the later abode is not merely longer life but life with undiverted, saving reality.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: - **Later enactment (`29:65-67`):** Crisis-only purity, post-rescue enjoyment, and trust in voidness show diversion and play as concrete allegiance dynamics. Near life diverts not because boats, land, or security are unreal, but because their immediate use displaces durable source-recognition.

findings.text: Dünya hayatının kusuru var olmaması değil, ikinci derecedeki uğraşların asıl kaygıyı ele geçirip eylemi kalıcı amaçtan saptırmasıdır.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: An activity expends motion without a sound end while another attraction turns attention away from the lasting object.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: play lacking a valid aim `quranic:root_001358:B001/m01`; wind playing through and erasing a place `quranic:root_001358:B005/m01`; occupation that turns one away from another object `quranic:root_001382:B001/m01`; amusement and enjoyed diversion `quranic:root_001382:B002/m01`; the near and lower life `quranic:root_000493:B002/m01`; what comes after the first `quranic:root_000019:B001/m01`; useless inactivity `quranic:root_000127:B005/m01`
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Worldly play is not condemned because it moves, but because its motion has no stable end and is easily erased like tracks under wind. Distraction compounds the loss by turning attention from the later reality that gives action an enduring object.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: The present life becomes a wager when sustenance is fed into an immediate contest whose apparent gain is produced by postponing the real settlement. The lunar root's gambling sense makes the created moon itself a pressure on treating the near world as a gaming table.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi bu dalı ölümün karşıtı olan canlılık durumu etrafında kurar; canlı kalmayı, yaşamın farklı güç ve düzeylerini, yeniden canlandırmayı ve ölümün düşünülemediği sürekli var oluşu da bu çekirdeğe bağlar.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal, yaşam durumunu ve onu başlatma ya da sürdürme işlemini kapsar; yağmur, karşılama sözü, utanma ve başka özel türevler ayrı dallarda kalır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Temel yaşam ve canlı olma anlamlarıyla, canlı kalma, canlandırma ve özel türevlerde beliren kullanımlar birbirinden ayrılarak tanımlanır.

concept_map.definition: Ölümün karşıtı olarak canlı olma ve canlı kalma durumudur; bir varlığı canlı kılma ya da yeniden canlandırma işlemini de kapsar. Bitkisel, duyusal ve düşünsel yaşam ile dünyadaki, sonraki ve ölmez var oluş bu çekirdeğin farklı gerçekleşmeleridir.

facets.statement: Bir varlığın ölü olmayıp canlı bulunması ve yaşamını sürdürmesi temel anlamdır.
Canlı kılma veya ölümden sonra yeniden canlandırma, temel durumun ettirgen ve yenileyici uzantısıdır.
Bitkisel büyüme, duyum, düşünme, dünya yaşamı, sonraki yaşam ve ölmez var oluş, canlılığın kaynakta ayrılan özel düzeyleridir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar ölüm karşıtı canlılık çekirdeğinde birleşir; toplu tanıklık ayrıca yaşamın güçlerini, sürekliliğini ve yeniden canlandırmayı bu çekirdeğin kapsamına alır.

concept_gloss.applicability: Genel tür adını, erkek birey adını ve bu alandaki türevleri kapsayan doğal karşılıktır.

error_profile.preserves: Yılan çekirdeğini, cinsiyet ayrımını ve ilişkili adlandırma alanını korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Özel biçimin yılanın erkek bireyini gösterdiği bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Cinsiyete bağlı özel adlandırmanın gönderimini korur.
error_profile.loses: Her iki cinsiyeti kapsayan genel tür adını ve köken tartışmasını kapsamaz.

neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Belirli bir yılan çeşidi, özellikle beyaz yılan okuması komşu dalın dar kapsamıdır.

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dal genel tür adıdır; komşu dal yılanlar içinde belirli bir çeşide verilen addır ve genel karşılık olarak kullanılamaz.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Boyut veya biçim sınırlaması olmadan genel yılan adı bu dala özgüdür.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: İrilik, kötücüllük, kısalık veya yuvarlaklık gibi niteliklerle tanımlanan özel yılan komşu dala özgüdür.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal yılanı doğrudan gönderim konusu yapar.

branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه الحية للذكر والأنثى، والحيوت ذكر الحيات، والنسبة والصاحب المتعامل مع الحيات عند من يشتقه من هذا الباب.

branches.source_phrase_ar: الحية معروف يقال حية ذكر وحية أنثى والحيوت ذكر الحيات (jamhara); الحية اشتقاقها من الحياة (ayn); الحية تكون للذكر والأنثى والحيوت ذكر الحيات (sihah); اشتقاق الحية من الحياة ومن قال حواء قال من حويت لأنها تتحوى (tahdhib)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi utanmayı yüzsüzlüğün karşıtı olarak verir ve kişinin kötü görülen davranışlardan içsel bir daralma nedeniyle kaçınmasını temel anlam sayar.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal içsel utanma ve kötüden çekinmeyle sınırlıdır; öldürmeyip sağ bırakma anlamındaki benzer biçim bu dala girmez.

lexicalization_scope.note: Temel utanma adı ile bir kişiden veya davranıştan utanmayı bildiren yapılar ayrı dil bilgisel gerçekleşmeler olarak korunur.

concept_map.definition: Kişinin kötü, uygunsuz veya yüz kızartıcı gördüğü şey karşısında içten daralması ve bu nedenle ondan kaçınmasıdır; yüzsüzlüğün karşıtı olarak değerlendirilir.

facets.statement: Kötü görülen şey karşısında duyulan içsel daralma ve utanma temel duygudur.
Bu duygu kişiyi kötü davranışı bırakmaya veya ondan uzak durmaya yöneltir.
Bir kişiden veya onun karşısında yapılan bir şeyden utanma, duygunun katılımcısı belirtilmiş kullanım biçimidir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar utanmayı yüzsüzlüğün karşıtı, kötü davranış karşısındaki içsel daralma ve o davranışı bırakmaya yönelten duygu olarak birlikte tanımlar.

concept_gloss.applicability: Duyguyu ve bu duygunun davranışı durdurucu sonucunu birlikte veren temel karşılıktır.

error_profile.preserves: İçsel utanmayı, kötüyle ilişkisini ve çekinme sonucunu korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Utanma duygusunun yöneldiği kişi veya neden açıkça belirtildiğinde kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Utanma duygusunu ve yöneldiği katılımcıyı doğal biçimde verir.
error_profile.loses: Duygunun kötü davranışı bırakmaya yönelten genel işlevini açıkça söylemez.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: ondan utandı ya da konuşmasına karşılık vermedi

neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal benzer sözcük yapılarıyla ifade edilir, fakat anlam çekirdekleri ortak değildir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dal bir duygu ve davranışsal çekinme bildirir; komşu dal ise bir kişinin yaşamına son vermeme eylemini bildirir.

branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه الحياء، والاستحياء، وحييت منه أو من فعل، والانقباض عن القبائح، وترك القبيح في حق الله عند تفسير الصفة.
branches.what_is_not_ar: لا يضم الاستبقاء وترك القتل في مثل يستحيون نساءكم، ولا العضو المسمى حياء إلا من جهة التسمية.
branches.source_phrase_ar: الاستحياء الذي هو ضد الوقاحة واستحييت منه (maqayis); حييت عن فلان إذا استحييت عنه (jamhara); حييت منه أحيا استحييت واستحياه واستحيا منه من الحياء (sihah); الحياء من الاستحياء ورجل حيي واستحيا الرجل (tahdhib); الحياء انقباض النفس عن القبائح وتركه (mufradat)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesinin çoğunluğu kadınları veya gençleri sağ bırakıp öldürmemeyi açıkça destekler. Buna karşılık toplu aktarımdaki bir parça bunun tersini söyleyen eksik ya da bozuk bir olumsuzluk içerdiğinden dal ancak bu metinsel karşıtlık belirtilerek kabul edilebilir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Tanım öldürmeyip sağ bırakma okumasını izler; karşıt yöndeki tek olumsuz aktarım kaynak içi uyuşmazlık olarak korunur.

lexicalization_scope.note: Anlam yalnız belirli kişileri sağ bırakmayı bildiren türemiş yapıdadır; temel biçime genel bir utanma veya yaşam anlamı olarak taşınmaz.

concept_map.definition: Kadınları, gençleri veya başka belirli kişileri öldürmeyip sağ bırakmaktır. Kaynakların baskın açıklaması bu yöndedir; tek bir karşıt olumsuz aktarım tanımın parçası değil, metinsel uyuşmazlıktır.

facets.statement: Öldürme imkânı veya tehdidi altında bulunan kişileri öldürmeyip canlı bırakmak temel işlemdir.
Kadınlar ve bir topluluğun gençleri kaynakta açıkça belirtilen kişi gruplarıdır.
Toplu aktarımın bir bölümündeki karşıt olumsuzluk, baskın sağ bırakma açıklamasıyla uyuşmayan metinsel bir değişkedir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Toplu kanıtın baskın yönü belirli kişileri sağ bırakmak ve öldürmemektir; aynı toplu iddiadaki tek karşıt olumsuzluk, kaynaklara ayrı ayrı bağlanamayan bir uyuşmazlık olarak not edilmelidir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Yalnız kişilerin yaşamına son verilmeyip korunması anlamındaki türemiş yapıya uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Öldürmeme işlemini ve kişinin canlı kalması sonucunu birlikte korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Kadınların öldürülmeyip canlı bırakıldığı tarihsel veya anlatısal bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Öldürmeme işlemini ve kadınların canlı kalması sonucunu açıkça verir.
error_profile.loses: Gençler veya başka kişi grupları üzerindeki daha geniş uygulamayı kapsamaz.

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dal yapıya bağlı olarak öldürmeme ve canlı bırakmayı bildirir; komşu dal bağışlama, acıma ve ilişkiyi koruma gibi daha geniş gerekçeler taşıyabilir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesinin ana çizgisi insanlar arasında esenlik, yaşam ve kalıcılık dileği taşıyan karşılama sözüdür. Aynı ifade içinde egemenlik yorumu da geçtiği için bu yorum çekirdeğe katılmamalı, ayrı bir kaynak değişkesi ve B008 ile kesişen okuma olarak gösterilmelidir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal karşılama, esenlik ve uzun ömür dileğine dayanır; egemenlik yorumu yalnız ayrı bir değişke olarak tutulur.

lexicalization_scope.note: Genel karşılama adı, yaşam ve esenlik dileyen kalıp ile bütün kalıcılığı yüce varlığa ayıran söz ayrı kullanımlar olarak korunur.

concept_map.definition: İnsanların birbirine esenlik, yaşam ve kalıcılık dilediği karşılama veya karşılık verme sözüdür. Bazı aktarımlarda aynı kalıp egemenlik bildirimi olarak yorumlandığından bu okuma ana anlamdan ayrı tutulur.

facets.statement: Bir kişiye yaşam, kalıcılık ve esenlik dilemek karşılama sözünün temel işlevidir.
İnsanların birbirini karşılaması ve esenlik sözünü karşılıklı iletmesi bu çekirdeğin toplumsal kullanımıdır.
Aynı sözün egemenlik bildirdiği yorumu, esenlik dileğinden ayrılması gereken bir kaynak değişkesidir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Toplu kanıt karşılama sözünü yaşam, kalıcılık ve esenlik dileği olarak açıklar; aynı toplu iddia içindeki egemenlik yorumu ise kaynaklara ayrıştırılamayan karşıt bir açıklama oluşturur.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi karşılama sözüyle aynı biçimi belirli bir yorumda egemenlik ve yönetme gücü olarak açıklar; ayrıca kalıplaşmış sözde bütün egemenliği yüce varlığa ayırır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal yalnız egemenlik yorumuna bağlıdır; esenlik bildiren olağan karşılama anlamı B007'de kalır.

facets.statement: Dişi hayvanın doğum zamanı yaklaşır ve hayvan doğurmaya yakın duruma gelir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesinin baskın açıklaması, ağız tavanının gerisinde boğaza doğru sarkan küçük et parçasıdır; aynı ifade bazı açıklamalarda ağzın en arka bölgesi olarak genişletilir. Dal çerçevesi iki sınırı da açıkça korur.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Temel anatomik gönderge küçük dildir; ağzın en arkası biçimindeki daha geniş açıklama kaynak değişkesi olarak ayrı tutulur.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım çıplak anatomik adı verir; başka dallardaki değirmen, armağan, oyun veya alıkoyma anlamlarını bu dala taşımaz.

concept_map.definition: Ağız tavanının en gerisinden boğaza doğru sarkan küçük et parçasıdır. Bazı açıklamalarda gönderge daha geniş tutularak ağzın en arka bölgesi diye verilir.

facets.statement: Ağız tavanının gerisinde bulunan ve boğazın üzerine doğru sarkan küçük et parçasını belirtir.
Bazı açıklamalar belirli et parçası yerine daha geniş olarak ağzın en arka bölgesini gönderge sayar.
Bir açıklama anatomik adın gerekçesini, yiyeceğin ağızdan geçerken bu bölgeye ulaşmasına bağlar.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynakların ortak odağı ağız ile boğazın birleştiği en arka bölgedir. Baskın tanım burada sarkan küçük et parçasını gösterir; daha geniş bir açıklama ağzın en arkasını öne çıkarır, bir adlandırma açıklaması da yiyeceğin bu bölgeye ulaşmasına dayanır.

İlk iki dal işlevsel olarak bağlantılıyken son iki dal daha somut ve bağımsız adlandırma kümeleri oluşturur.

identity_judgment.rationale: Dal ifadesi, oyunu ciddi ve geçerli bir amaca yönelmeyen eğlenceli ya da şakacı davranış olarak kurar; yineleme, oyuna düşkün kişi, oyun aracı, oyun türü, oyun yeri, meslek ve karşılıklı katılım değerlerini de bu çekirdeğe bağlı türevler olarak verir. Bu çerçeve dalın kapsamını doğru biçimde temsil eder.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Çekirdek oyun eylemidir; salya, hayvansal ürün, sıcaklık görüntüsü ve öteki eşsesli dallar bu kapsama girmez.

lexicalization_scope.note: Yalın eylem ciddi bir amaç gütmeyen oynama ya da şakalaşmadır; biçim ve kalıp türevleri tekrar, kişi, araç, yer, meslek ve karşılıklı katılım değerlerini ayrıca taşır.

concept_map.definition: Oyun, eğlenme ya da şakalaşma amacıyla yapılan ve ciddi, geçerli bir sonuca yönelmeyen davranıştır. Türevler bunun yinelenmesini, bunu sık yapan kişiyi, oyunun türünü, aracını, yerini, mesleğini ve başkasıyla birlikte yapılmasını bildirir.

facets.statement: Ciddi bir amaca yönelmeyen eğlenceli veya şakacı davranışta bulunma çekirdeği vardır.
Eylemin tekrar tekrar yapılması ve kişinin oyuna çok düşkün olması bu çekirdeğin süreklilik ve kişi uzantılarıdır.
Oyun türü, tek bir oynama, oyun aracı, oyun yeri, oyun giysisi ve oyunculuğu meslek edinmiş kişi adları türetilir.
Belirli kalıplar çok oynayan genç kızı veya başka biriyle karşılıklı oynamayı anlatır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Ortak içerik, ciddi ve geçerli bir amaca yönelmeyen oyun davranışını çekirdek alır; tekrarlama, oyuna düşkün kişi, oyun nesnesi ve türü, tek oynama, oyun yeri, oyun giysisi, meslek ve karşılıklı oynama değerlerini buna bağlı olarak toplar.

identity_judgment.rationale: Dal ifadesi ağızdan, özellikle çocuğun ağzından akan salyayı merkeze alır ve çocuğun salyasının akması, akmaya başlaması ile ağzın salyalı olması biçimlerini aynı akış durumuna bağlar. Bu kapsam kanıtlanan anlamı eksiksiz ve tutarlı biçimde temsil eder.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bu dal ağızdan akan gerçek vücut sıvısıyla sınırlıdır; oyun eylemi, arı balı, yılan zehri ve sıcaklık görüntüsü değildir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Yalın ad ağızdan akan salyayı bildirir; kalıplaşmış eylem ve nitelemeler çocuktaki akışı, akışın başlamasını veya ağızda salya bulunmasını ayrıca anlatır.

concept_map.definition: Ağızdan, özellikle çocuğun ağzından kendiliğinden akıp dışarı çıkan tükürük bu dalın çekirdeğidir. Türev kalıplar bu akışın gerçekleşmesini, başlamasını ya da ağızda salya bulunmasını bildirir.

facets.statement: Ağızdan dışarı akan tükürük, yani salya, dalın temel gönderimidir.
Çocuğun salyasının akması, çekirdek sıvının görüldüğü temel eylem durumudur.
Çocuğun salyasının akmaya başlaması, durumun ortaya çıkışını bildiren bir uzantıdır.
Ağzın salyalı diye nitelenmesi, sıvının bulunduğu yeri öne çıkaran kullanımdır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Ortak anlatım salyayı ağızdan, çoğu örnekte çocuğun ağzından akan tükürük olarak tanımlar; ilgili biçimler salyanın akmasını, akmaya başlamasını ve ağızda bulunmasını bildirir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Dalın sıvı çekirdeğini doğal biçimde karşılar; akışın başlaması ve salyalı ağız gibi türev durumlar bağlamda ayrıca kurulur.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, bir şeyin başka bir şeyi çevresinden kuşatmasını temel alırken dönme hareketini, tek dönüşü, döndürmeyi ve yuvarlak biçimi de aynı anlam alanında toplar. Hazırlanan dal çerçevesi bu fiziksel çekirdeği ve ondan doğan biçimsel kullanımları doğru yansıtır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bu dal fiziksel dönme, çevresini dolanma ve yuvarlak biçimle sınırlıdır; konut, kötü olay, baş dönmesi ve özel adlaşmış nesne anlamları ayrı dallardadır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Dal hem bağımsız biçimleri hem de belirli fiil öbeklerini içerir. Dönme ve çevreleme çekirdeği geneldir; bir şeyi döndürme ya da yuvarlaklaştırma anlamları yalnız ilgili yapılara bağlanır.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyin bir merkez ya da başka bir şey çevresinde dönmesi, çevresini dolanması veya onu kuşatmasıdır. Bu çekirdekten yuvarlak çizgi ve biçim ile bir şeyi döndürme ya da yuvarlaklaştırma gibi yapıya bağlı anlamlar gelişir.

facets.statement: Bir şey bir merkez çevresinde döner ya da başka bir şeyin çevresini dolanıp kuşatır.
Hareketin bir kez tamamlanması tek bir dönüş olarak belirtilir.
Çevreleyen hareket, yuvarlak bir çizgiye, halkaya veya yuvarlak nesneye aktarılır.
Belirli yapılarda bir nesneyi döndürmek veya ona yuvarlak biçim vermek anlatılır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynakların ortak çizgisi, çevrede hareket etme ile bir şeyi çevresinden kuşatma arasındaki bağdır. Tek dönüş, hareketin odağı, yuvarlak çizgi ve bir nesneye bu hareketi yaptırma aynı çekirdeğin farklı gerçekleşmeleridir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Fiziksel hareket ile bu hareketin oluşturduğu kuşatıcı veya yuvarlak biçimi birlikte anlatan en kısa karşılıktır.

error_profile.preserves: Dönme hareketini, çevreyi dolanmayı ve kuşatıcı biçimi birlikte korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir nesnenin merkez ya da başka bir nesne çevresindeki gerçek hareketi için kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Çevresel ve tekrarlanabilir hareketi açık biçimde korur.
error_profile.loses: Yuvarlak biçim ile bir şeyi döndürme veya yuvarlaklaştırma uzantılarını dışarıda bırakır.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir nesneye dönme hareketi yaptıran veya ona yuvarlak biçim veren yapılarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Ettirgen biçim verme sonucunu ve yuvarlaklık ilişkisini korur.
error_profile.loses: Öznenin kendi dönmesini ve başka bir şeyi çevrelemesini kapsamaz.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi konut ve insanların yerleştiği yeri çekirdek alır; ancak kabile, belde, bölge, bu yaşam ve öte yaşam gibi daha geniş kullanımları da açıkça kapsar. Bu nedenle insanları çevreleyen yer çerçevesi kullanılabilir, fakat yalnız yapı veya ev olarak anlaşılmamalıdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal, yerleşilen yapıdan topluluğun yurduna ve adlandırılmış yaşam alanlarına uzanır; salt dönme hareketi ile bağımsız manastır kümesi bu sınıra girmez.

lexicalization_scope.note: Bağımsız konut ve yer biçimleri ile belirli adlandırma öbekleri birlikte bulunur. Genel tanım yerleşilen ve sınırlandırılan yeri anlatır; öte yaşam ve benzeri özel karşılıklar yalnız kendi öbeklerinde geçerlidir.

concept_map.definition: İnsanların yerleştiği yapı, çevrili alan veya daha geniş yurt ve bölgedir. Anlam, orada yaşayan topluluğa ve belirli yaşam ya da son durak alanlarını adlandıran yapılara da aktarılabilir.

facets.statement: İnsanların içinde yaşadığı yapı, arsa ve yakın çevresinden oluşan yerleşim birimidir.
Konut anlamı, beldeye, bölgeye ve bir topluluğun yurduna kadar genişler.
Yer adı, orada yaşayan kabileyi veya topluluğu da gösterebilir.
Daha dar bir biçim, çevresi doğal yükseltilerle veya başka bir sınırla kuşatılan özel yeri anlatır.
Belirli öbeklerde bu yaşamın, öte yaşamın, esenliğin veya yıkımın kalıcı yurdu adlandırılır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynakların ortak anlatımı, yerleşilen konutu arsa, yapı ve mahalleyle birlikte ele alır; aynı adın kabile, belde, bölge ve bütün bir yaşam alanı için kullanılabildiğini gösterir. Daha dar yer biçimi ise çevresi belirgin biçimde kuşatılmış alanı anlatır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi zamanın insanları bir durumdan başka bir duruma geçirmesini, koşulların el değiştirmesini ve işlerin evirilip çevrilerek ele alınmasını birlikte verir. Dal çerçevesi bu soyut dönüş ve uğraşma alanını fiziksel dönmeden ayırarak doğru kurar.

concept_map.definition: Zamanın insanları değişen durumlar içinden geçirmesi ve koşulların sırayla el değiştirmesidir. Belirli bir yapıda aynı dönüş düşüncesi, işleri çeşitli yönleriyle ele alıp yürütmeyi anlatır.

facets.statement: Zaman insanı bir durumdan başka bir duruma geçirir ve koşulları değiştirir.
Durumlar veya üstünlük sırası kişiler arasında el değiştirir.
Belirli bir söz öbeği, işleri evirip çevirerek değerlendirmeyi ve yürütmeyi anlatır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Ortak anlatım, zamanın insan yaşamındaki durumları döndürüp değiştirmesini öne çıkarır. Aynı düzen, koşulların el değiştirmesine ve bir işin farklı yönlerine dönülerek işlenmesine uygulanır.
